translations.web: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot; Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear:
translations.bsb: then indeed you will lift up your face without blemish; you will stand firm and unafraid.
translations.kjv: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
